text:
sanjay: Quick sync — Q4 capacity ask. Forecasts show a 28% peak increase for hosted API in Nov-Dec vs baseline. Need decisions on buy vs short-term lease and warm-pool sizing. Thoughts?
erica: Can you paste the forecast numbers? is that peak qps or token/sec?
sanjay: Peak token/sec estimated 2.6M (90th percentile). That maps to ~160 GPU-hours/day if we keep current model mix (gpt-like open models).
leo: 160 GPU-hrs/day baseline peak. What margin are we targeting? 20% headroom?
sanjay: We should target 30% headroom for holiday surge + regional failover. So ~208 GPU-hrs/day at peak.
maya: Ok — options: (A) buy 30 A100s (capex) — lowers unit cost but long lead time. (B) 12-month lease + spot rentals for bursts. (C) staggered pool + warm instances in eu-west1 only.
jen: Timeline matters — procurement lead for buys is ~12 weeks. For Q4 spike we need capacity in 6–8 weeks. Leasing looks more realistic.
erica: Also network constraint: eu-west1 egress cap might limit cross-region routing for burst fallback. If we rely on cross-region, we need a plan for regional warm pools, not global fallback.
leo: Cost quick calc: buy 30 A100 -> one-time ~$3.3M street price (placeholder) + infra ops. Lease for 6 months ~ $0.15M/mo + brokers. Short-term rentals have high unit cost but fast.
maya: Benchmarking note: model-variant fallback increases GPU efficiency by 12% if we allow 8-bit quantized variants for non-critical tiers. That can shave needed GPUs by ~10.
ops-bot: Reminder: last purchase window inventory ETA updated: vendor X has 10 units available w/ 10-week lead, vendor Y backorder ~18 weeks.
jen: Proposal: hybrid approach: commit to 12 leased GPUs now (6wk start), increase warm pool to 25% of peak (~52 GPU-hours persistent), and schedule buy evaluation post-Q4 if price and demand justify.
sanjay: Sounds reasonable. Can someone map this to GPU-hours and cost estimate for exec? I need north-star numbers by EOD Friday.
erica: I'll run a quick sim: input = 2.6M token/sec peak, model mix, 30% headroom, warm pool 25%. Output in hours and $/token.
leo: I'll fetch vendor lead times and draft ordering cadence for staggered buys if we decide buy-later.
maya: Also recommend enabling "model-variant fallback" on low-tier plans and activating prefix caching for repeat traffic during promotions — operational savings could be ~15% token cost during surge.
jen: Ops action items: 
- erica: simulation and cost numbers (EOD Fri)
- leo: vendor availability + suggested tranche schedule (Mon)
- infra: pre-authorize 6-week lease (procurement) to lock capacity window
- ops-bot: open a procurement ticket
sanjay: Agree. One more: confirm SLA impact if we divert EU traffic to US under heavy load (latency increase estimates).
erica: I'll include latency delta matrix in sim.
leo: FYI — we should run a 24hr soak with warm pool config in staging next week to validate cold-starts and kv cache hit behavior.
maya: +1. schedule soak and include telemetry for per-route tail-latency.
jen: Created procurement ticket #PR-8247 and tagged @procurement, linked to this thread. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Ticket PR-8247 created by jen. Vendor outreach pending.
sanjay: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene Tue with sims. :thumbsup:
